title: DoorDash Bench

spec.score: 100 * (1 - multiclass Brier loss / 2), averaged across all four tasks
spec.brier_loss: sum((probability - one_hot_truth) ** 2) across the fixed meal choices
spec.task_isolation: one fresh CLI session per task; no shared history/context or session resume
spec.menu_scope: static meal choices from the history; known-menu prediction, not discovery of unseen restaurants
spec.normalization: reject probability sums more than 0.005 from 1; otherwise normalize rounding error
spec.cost_basis: CLI estimates are not invoices; token counts include reported input/cache/reasoning/output

reference_prices.basis: Standard short-context API-equivalent pricing, not subscription billing

cost_analysis.basis: Estimated API-equivalent prediction cost. Includes CLI context/cache/output; excludes shared setup/evaluator and subscription fees.

excluded_development_attempt.reason: Menu IDs encoded recency; canonical alphabetical IDs fixed before accepting the leaderboard. First attempt retained privately under .scratch/excluded-v2.

setup.text: {"guide":"For each task, assign a probability to every fixed meal choice from the provided history, using patterns like frequency, recency, and timing. Probabilities must be nonnegative and sum to 1 (within 0.005). Avoid overconfidence, since Brier loss penalizes confident misses. Predict only known menu items; each task runs in isolation.","score_explanation":"Score is 100 × (1 − Brier loss/2), averaged over all four tasks. Brier loss sums squared errors against the true meal. Lower loss gives a higher score; 100 is perfect."}
